title: Venezuela's Acting President Delcy Rodriguez Visits India, Meets PM Modi
detail: Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodriguez arrived in New Delhi for an official visit and met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The diplomatic outreach signals Venezuela's effort to diversify partnerships and reduce dependence on traditional allies amid sustained US sanctions, while India seeks to expand energy and trade ties with Latin American nations.

media.caption: Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodriguez arrives in India for talks with PM Modi
